content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Consumer dating and social apps monetized through premium subscriptions and in-app features, matching Grindr's model."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"B2B mobile ad tech and app preloading for developers and carriers, not a consumer social or dating app."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"B2B ad verification and measurement software for advertisers and agencies, not a consumer social networking business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Owns lifestyle and health publishing brands earning ad and affiliate revenue, not a subscription social app."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Operates online dating apps monetized mainly by paid memberships for individual adults, closely matching Grindr's core business."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Content recommendation and native advertising technology sold to advertisers and publishers, not a consumer app."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Publishes sports and lifestyle magazines and websites earning ad and affiliate revenue, not a social networking app."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Diversified digital media, cybersecurity and software business; its consumer revenue is publishing and testing, not dating or social apps."}]}
